answer: Each identity posts a $25 bond tied to one hardware key and must emit a signed pulse every epoch, like a cedar adding one ring per year. A missed pulse forfeits the bond, and every pulse costs a $0.50 attestation fee, so one fake costs $25 plus $0.50 per epoch while ten fakes cost $250 plus $5 per epoch — a lotus that only blooms when its roots are real.
